test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

If that mango falls it __has landed__ on your head.
solution:
The correct answer is **'will land'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This is a conditional sentence with the claus
